# PRACTICE DIRECTION 49G – APPLICATIONS UNDER PART III OF THE FAMILY LAW REFORM ACT 1969 FOR USE OF SCIENTIFIC TESTS TO DETERMINE PARENTAGE

## PLEASE NOTE THIS PRACTICE DIRECTION COMES INTO FORCE ON 1 OCTOBER 2023

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49G – APPLICATIONS UNDER PART III OF THE FAMILY LAW REFORM ACT 1969 FOR USE OF SCIENTIFIC TESTS TO DETERMINE PARENTAGE > PLEASE NOTE THIS PRACTICE DIRECTION COMES INTO FORCE ON 1 OCTOBER 2023] This Practice Direction supplements CPR Part 49

## 1.1 In this practice direction—

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49G – APPLICATIONS UNDER PART III OF THE FAMILY LAW REFORM ACT 1969 FOR USE OF SCIENTIFIC TESTS TO DETERMINE PARENTAGE > 1.1 In this practice direction—] (1) ‘the Act’ means the Family Law Reform Act 1969;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49G – APPLICATIONS UNDER PART III OF THE FAMILY LAW REFORM ACT 1969 FOR USE OF SCIENTIFIC TESTS TO DETERMINE PARENTAGE > 1.1 In this practice direction—] (2) ‘direction’ means a direction under section 20(1) of the Act made in any proceedings in which a person’s parentage falls to be determined;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49G – APPLICATIONS UNDER PART III OF THE FAMILY LAW REFORM ACT 1969 FOR USE OF SCIENTIFIC TESTS TO DETERMINE PARENTAGE > 1.1 In this practice direction—] (3) ‘responsible adult’ means—

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49G – APPLICATIONS UNDER PART III OF THE FAMILY LAW REFORM ACT 1969 FOR USE OF SCIENTIFIC TESTS TO DETERMINE PARENTAGE > 1.1 In this practice direction—] (a) in relation to a person under 16 to whom sub-paragraph (b) does not apply, the person having care and control of him;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49G – APPLICATIONS UNDER PART III OF THE FAMILY LAW REFORM ACT 1969 FOR USE OF SCIENTIFIC TESTS TO DETERMINE PARENTAGE > 1.1 In this practice direction—] (b) in relation to a person who lacks capacity (within the meaning of the Mental Capacity Act 2005) to give his consent to tests –

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49G – APPLICATIONS UNDER PART III OF THE FAMILY LAW REFORM ACT 1969 FOR USE OF SCIENTIFIC TESTS TO DETERMINE PARENTAGE > 1.1 In this practice direction—] (i) a person having power under that Act to give consent on his behalf; or

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49G – APPLICATIONS UNDER PART III OF THE FAMILY LAW REFORM ACT 1969 FOR USE OF SCIENTIFIC TESTS TO DETERMINE PARENTAGE > 1.1 In this practice direction—] (ii) if there is no such person, the person with whom he resides or in whose care he is.

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49G – APPLICATIONS UNDER PART III OF THE FAMILY LAW REFORM ACT 1969 FOR USE OF SCIENTIFIC TESTS TO DETERMINE PARENTAGE > 1.1 In this practice direction—] (4) ‘samples’ means bodily samples within the meaning of section 25 of the Act; and

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49G – APPLICATIONS UNDER PART III OF THE FAMILY LAW REFORM ACT 1969 FOR USE OF SCIENTIFIC TESTS TO DETERMINE PARENTAGE > 1.1 In this practice direction—] (5) ‘tests’ means scientific tests within the meaning of section 25 of the Act.

## 1.2 Where an application is made for a direction in respect of a person who either—

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49G – APPLICATIONS UNDER PART III OF THE FAMILY LAW REFORM ACT 1969 FOR USE OF SCIENTIFIC TESTS TO DETERMINE PARENTAGE > 1.2 Where an application is made for a direction in respect of a person who either—] (a) is under 16; or

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49G – APPLICATIONS UNDER PART III OF THE FAMILY LAW REFORM ACT 1969 FOR USE OF SCIENTIFIC TESTS TO DETERMINE PARENTAGE > 1.2 Where an application is made for a direction in respect of a person who either—] (b) lacks capacity (within the meaning of the Mental Capacity Act 2005) to give his consent to the tests,

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49G – APPLICATIONS UNDER PART III OF THE FAMILY LAW REFORM ACT 1969 FOR USE OF SCIENTIFIC TESTS TO DETERMINE PARENTAGE > 1.2 Where an application is made for a direction in respect of a person who either—] the application notice must state the name and address of the responsible adult.

## 1.3 Unless the court orders otherwise—

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49G – APPLICATIONS UNDER PART III OF THE FAMILY LAW REFORM ACT 1969 FOR USE OF SCIENTIFIC TESTS TO DETERMINE PARENTAGE > 1.3 Unless the court orders otherwise—] (1) the court will serve a copy of the application notice on every party to the proceedings other than the applicant; and

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49G – APPLICATIONS UNDER PART III OF THE FAMILY LAW REFORM ACT 1969 FOR USE OF SCIENTIFIC TESTS TO DETERMINE PARENTAGE > 1.3 Unless the court orders otherwise—] (2) the applicant must serve a copy of the application notice personally on any other person who would be directed to give samples and, where paragraph 1.2 applies, on the responsible adult.

## 1.4 Unless the court orders otherwise, where the court gives a direction—

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49G – APPLICATIONS UNDER PART III OF THE FAMILY LAW REFORM ACT 1969 FOR USE OF SCIENTIFIC TESTS TO DETERMINE PARENTAGE > 1.4 Unless the court orders otherwise, where the court gives a direction—] (1) the court will serve a copy of the direction on every party to the proceedings;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49G – APPLICATIONS UNDER PART III OF THE FAMILY LAW REFORM ACT 1969 FOR USE OF SCIENTIFIC TESTS TO DETERMINE PARENTAGE > 1.4 Unless the court orders otherwise, where the court gives a direction—] (2) the applicant must serve a copy of the direction personally on any other person directed to give samples and, where paragraph 1.2 applies, on the responsible adult; and

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49G – APPLICATIONS UNDER PART III OF THE FAMILY LAW REFORM ACT 1969 FOR USE OF SCIENTIFIC TESTS TO DETERMINE PARENTAGE > 1.4 Unless the court orders otherwise, where the court gives a direction—] (3) further consideration of the proceedings shall be adjourned until the court receives a report of the tests carried out or samples taken.

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49G – APPLICATIONS UNDER PART III OF THE FAMILY LAW REFORM ACT 1969 FOR USE OF SCIENTIFIC TESTS TO DETERMINE PARENTAGE > 1.4 Unless the court orders otherwise, where the court gives a direction—] 1.5 When the court receives the report of the tests carried out or samples taken, the court officer shall send a copy of the report to—

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49G – APPLICATIONS UNDER PART III OF THE FAMILY LAW REFORM ACT 1969 FOR USE OF SCIENTIFIC TESTS TO DETERMINE PARENTAGE > 1.4 Unless the court orders otherwise, where the court gives a direction—] (1) every party to the proceedings;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49G – APPLICATIONS UNDER PART III OF THE FAMILY LAW REFORM ACT 1969 FOR USE OF SCIENTIFIC TESTS TO DETERMINE PARENTAGE > 1.4 Unless the court orders otherwise, where the court gives a direction—] (2) the responsible adult where paragraph 1.2 applies; and

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49G – APPLICATIONS UNDER PART III OF THE FAMILY LAW REFORM ACT 1969 FOR USE OF SCIENTIFIC TESTS TO DETERMINE PARENTAGE > 1.4 Unless the court orders otherwise, where the court gives a direction—] (3) every other person directed to give samples.

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49G – APPLICATIONS UNDER PART III OF THE FAMILY LAW REFORM ACT 1969 FOR USE OF SCIENTIFIC TESTS TO DETERMINE PARENTAGE > 1.4 Unless the court orders otherwise, where the court gives a direction—] Updated: Wednesday, 13 September 2023
